column2: A gentle melancholy settled over her as she watched the last leaves fall from the trees.
column3: 看著最後幾片葉子從樹上飄落，一股淡淡的憂鬱籠罩了她。
column4: a touch of melancholy (一絲憂鬱)
column5: 諧音「沒藍可理」，藍色心情沒人理，好憂鬱

column2: A common misconception is that lightning never strikes the same place twice.
column3: 一個常見的誤解是，閃電不會劈中同一個地方兩次。
column5: mis 錯 + conception 想法，想法想錯了

column2: The signing of the treaty was a momentous occasion that reshaped the borders of Europe.
column3: 條約的簽署是個重大時刻，重新劃定了歐洲的邊界。
column5: moment 時刻 + ous，值得記一輩子的那個時刻
column8: 重大；關鍵；深具歷史意義的

column2: The long drive across the flat desert was monotonous, with nothing to see but sand.
column3: 穿越平坦沙漠的長途駕駛很單調，除了沙子什麼也看不到。
column4: a monotonous routine (單調的例行公事)
column5: mono 單一 + tone 音調，同一個調子聽到想睡

column2: A mournful bell tolled across the valley as villagers gathered to remember the lost sailors.
column3: 村民聚在一起追思失蹤的水手時，哀傷的鐘聲迴盪在山谷間。
column5: mourn 哀悼 + ful 充滿，諧音「摸你」安慰你

column2: He was naive enough to believe the stranger's promise of easy money.
column3: 他天真到相信陌生人輕鬆賺錢的承諾。
column5: 想像剛出社會、什麼話都信的小白兔
column8: 天真；幼稚；缺乏世故歷練的

column2: Her memoir is less a list of dates than a gripping narrative of survival.
column3: 她的回憶錄與其說是日期的清單，不如說是一則扣人心弦的求生敘事。
column4: a gripping narrative (扣人心弦的敘事)
column5: narr 講述（narrator 旁白），把事情一段段講成故事

column2: The company was found negligent for ignoring repeated warnings about the cracked bridge supports.
column3: 公司因無視橋墩裂縫的多次警告，被認定有疏忽。
column5: neglect 忽略的形容詞，忘了關瓦斯就是 negligent

column2: Adding a base can neutralize an acid, producing water and a harmless salt.
column3: 加入鹼可以中和酸，產生水和無害的鹽。
column5: neutral 中性 + ize 使，把它變成不酸不鹼

column2: He paid only a nominal fee, just enough to make the contract legally binding.
column3: 他只付了象徵性的費用，剛好足以讓合約具有法律效力。
column4: a nominal fee (象徵性的費用)
column5: nomin 名字（name），只有名字掛著，實際上很少
column8: 名義上；微不足道；象徵性的

column2: The novelty of the robot toy wore off after a week, and the children stopped playing with it.
column3: 機器人玩具的新鮮感一週後就消退了，孩子們不再玩它。
column5: nov 新（novel 新穎的），新到讓人好奇的感覺

column2: The court's ruling nullified the contract, so neither company had to honor its terms.
column3: 法院的判決使合約無效，兩家公司都不必遵守其條款。
column5: null 零 + ify 使成為，把效力歸零

column2: Fallen trees obstructed the road, forcing the ambulance to take a longer route.
column3: 倒下的樹木擋住了道路，迫使救護車繞較遠的路。
column5: ob 擋在前面 + struct 建造，築起一道牆擋路

column2: In the myth, the omnipotent king could command the seas, the winds, and the stars.
column3: 在神話中，無所不能的國王能號令海洋、風與星辰。
column4: an omnipotent ruler (全能的統治者)
column5: omni 全部 + potent 有力，什麼力量都在他手上
column8: 全能；全權掌控；無所不能的

column2: The famed orator held the crowd silent for an hour with her stirring speech on justice.
column3: 這位著名的演說家以一場激勵人心的正義演說，讓群眾安靜聽了一小時。
column4: a gifted orator (有天賦的演說家)
column5: or 口（oral 口頭的）+ ator 人，靠一張嘴打動人

column2: The ornate ceiling of the old theater was covered in gold leaf and carved flowers.
column3: 老劇院華麗繁複的天花板貼滿金箔，雕著一朵朵花。
column5: orn 裝飾（ornament 小飾品），裝飾多到滿出來
column8: 華麗；繁複；過度裝飾；雕琢的

column2: Classmates ostracized the new student after a rumor spread, leaving her alone at lunch.
column3: 謠言傳開後，同學們排擠這位新生，讓她午餐時獨自一人。
column4: ostracize a member (排擠一名成員)
column5: 古希臘人用陶片（ostrakon）投票，把人趕出城
column8: 放逐；排擠；排斥；逐出社會

column2: Patient safety is paramount in any hospital, taking priority over cost and convenience.
column3: 在任何醫院裡，病人安全都是最重要的，優先於成本與方便。
column5: mount 山頭，登上最高的山頭，位置至高無上
column8: 至高無上；最為核心；重要的

column2: The perilous mountain path wound along a cliff with no railing and loose gravel.
column3: 險惡的山路沿著沒有欄杆、滿是碎石的懸崖蜿蜒而上。
column5: 字裡有 peril 危險，加 ous 就是充滿危險

column2: Many seedlings perished during the frost because the farmers had no way to keep them warm.
column3: 霜凍期間許多幼苗枯死，因為農民沒辦法替它們保暖。
column4: perish in the cold (在寒冷中喪生)
column5: 想像放太久的水果壞掉，perishable 就是易腐壞

column2: Repeating old stereotypes only perpetuates unfair ideas about who can succeed in science.
column3: 一再重複舊的刻板印象，只會讓「誰能在科學上成功」的不公平觀念延續下去。
column5: perpetual 永久的 + ate 使，讓它永遠繼續

column2: She looked perplexed as she studied the map, unable to tell which road led home.
column3: 她研究地圖時一臉困惑，分不清哪條路通往回家。
column5: per 徹底 + plex 編織（complex），線纏成一團

column2: The regime persecuted religious minorities, forcing many families to flee across the border.
column3: 該政權迫害宗教少數群體，迫使許多家庭逃過邊界。
column5: per 一路 + secute 追趕，一路追著欺負人
column8: 迫害；迫害宗教與族群；殘害

column2: Though the first ten attempts failed, the inventor persevered and finally built a working engine.
column3: 雖然前十次嘗試都失敗，發明家仍堅持下去，終於做出能運轉的引擎。
column4: persevere through hardship (在困境中堅持)
column5: per 徹底 + severe 嚴格，對自己嚴格到底

column2: He felt pessimistic about the weather and expected rain to ruin the picnic.
column3: 他對天氣很悲觀，預期下雨會毀掉野餐。
column5: pessimistic 想最糟；optimistic 想最好

column2: It seems petty to argue over a few cents when the whole group is raising money for charity.
column3: 整個團體都在為慈善募款時，還為了幾分錢爭吵，顯得很小氣。
column5: petty 像 pet 小寵物，小小的、不重要的小事
column8: 瑣碎；微小不重要；氣量狹小的

column2: Marie Curie was a pioneer in radioactivity research, opening doors for later scientists.
column3: 居禮夫人是放射性研究的先驅，為後來的科學家開了路。
column4: a pioneer in medicine (醫學的先驅)
column5: 諧音「派你兒」，派你先去探路的人

column2: The pious farmer prayed every morning before sunrise and gave a share of his harvest to the poor.
column3: 虔誠的農夫每天日出前禱告，並把一部分收成分給窮人。
column5: pious 唸起來像「派」，派去禮拜的人很虔誠

column2: The old soldier's poignant letter to his family brought many readers to tears.
column3: 老兵寫給家人的動人書信讓許多讀者落淚。
column4: a poignant memory (令人心酸的回憶)
column5: poign 像 point 尖，像小刺扎進心裡酸酸的
column8: 深刻；淒切；令人心酸動容的
